note: Adapted from the species description of Speculitermes triangularis in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; neither the alate nor the soldier is recorded, only the worker; synonymy citations, figure references and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to pale straw; postclypeus and labrum slightly paler than head capsule; antennae and legs yellowish white; abdomen transparent white. Head and body surface moderately pilose. Total body length about 4.5-6.00 mm. Head subcircular (length to mandible base 1.05-1.10 mm, maximum width 1.30-1.35 mm); mid-dorsal spot translucent white, triangular (length 0.20, width 0.30 mm), flush with the dorsum of the head; Y-shaped suture faint. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 shortest, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 as long as segment 2. Postclypeus strongly raised and pilose, longitudinally divided into two halves, about as long as half its width, anterior and posterior margins straight. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior and posterior margins rounded, without notches (length 0.40-0.45, width 0.75-0.80 mm). Legs slender; tibial spur formula usually 2:2:2, sometimes 3:2:2, dorsal spur very minute when present.
